Delete your AdultingOS account

AdultingOS has no e-mail or password sign-in. Each installation of the app has its own private account, so your account is deleted from inside the app.

How to delete your account

  1. Open AdultingOS.
  2. Go to Profile → Privacy and security → Delete my account.
  3. Type DELETE and tap Delete my account permanently.

Deletion is immediate. You can also export a copy first: Profile → Export my data.

What is deleted

Your account, tasks, bills, payments, documents, subscriptions, settings, achievements, consent history and Ask Adu conversations are permanently deleted, along with all AdultingOS data on your phone. We keep a record that a deletion happened (without your identity) and the text of feedback you sent, with your identity removed. Backups are overwritten within 30 days.

If you no longer have the app

Without the app, nobody can open your account — not even you. Accounts with no activity for 12 months are deleted automatically, with all their data.

For any other privacy or deletion request, e-mail work.patkyu@gmail.com.
